scope: repair only the frozen PR-001 through PR-011 pressure findings; no admission, qualification, canonicality, or production authority

repairs.repair: standing-envelope support now requires VERIFIED state plus evidence bindings verified by evidence_id, role, artifact, subject identity, PRESENT status, and SHA-256 bytes
authorization, occurrence, and effectivity now separate asserted_status from verification_status and each requires its own evidence bindings
evidence matching now verifies evidence_id, role, artifact, SHA-256, exact subject identity, PRESENT status, and bytes
transition basis requires evidence bindings and basis-type-specific evidence roles; reference presence alone is insufficient
runtime strict-contract validation rejects undeclared or missing fields before evaluation
a predecessor state is temporal-promotion classified only after the superseding transition independently satisfies the full evidence/authority/effectivity/basis gate
normalized assertions now carry normalizer identity, method, DESCRIPTIVE_MAPPING_ONLY authority, and bounded coverage status
temporal anchors now carry source class and verification status; inferred, absent, ambiguous, or unverified anchors yield INDETERMINATE
scope and non-effects are typed coordinates over subject object, dimension, surface, and claim
per-assertion output uses typed semantic dispositions while retaining PASS/WITHHOLD/INDETERMINATE only as execution actions
regression population expanded from 6 to 22 tests, including the frozen oracle-reintroduction pressure paths
